eval.description: Anthropic’s internal alignment audit. An investigator model probes the target across thousands of seeded scenarios (about 4,000 investigations and about 1,900 scenario seeds in the Opus 5.5 card), including sandboxed computer-use and Claude Code sessions. A judge model scores each investigation on several dozen misuse, misalignment, honesty, cooperation, and character dimensions (0–10; lower is usually better).
eval.summary: Measures how often the model shows misuse, dishonesty, sabotage, or other misaligned behavior across many simulated scenarios.

links.title: Building and evaluating alignment auditing agents

versions.changes: Current form as in the Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1 and Opus 5.5 cards: roughly four thousand investigations over about two thousand handwritten scenario seeds, with sandbox and Claude Code affordances.

scores.description: Judge score for one audit dimension on one investigation (0–10). Absolute values depend on the seed mix; cards use them mainly to compare models.

metrics.description: Mean judge score for a named dimension across all investigations (for example misaligned behavior).
